item.title: Meet the amazing Coral! - When life seems too much #SICKNOTSAD
item.description: Coral got on board with our #SickNotSad campaign, and we started talking. It turns out that this lovely lady not only loves her coffee; she is an amazing blogger. She has written a fantastic blog for us and has said that not only can I send you to her site to read the blog, but I can also write it out below. Hopefully this is the first of many linkups with bloggers, and especially Coral!
